answers.core: This feature is about improving the core capabilities of the Godot engine's lighting system and I think would improve stylistic rendering capability in godot.
answers.workaround: This can be partially worked around with custom shaders and scripts, but it is not convenient and lacks the flexibility and ease of use that a built-in solution would provide. Implementing this feature directly in the engine will make it more accessible and user-friendly.

title: Add light linking for 3D and 2D lights
